disclaimer.title: Mindra is a tracker, not medical advice
disclaimer.body: This app helps you notice patterns in your training and how your body feels. It does not diagnose, treat, or evaluate medical conditions, and the patterns it shows are not predictions about your health.
disclaimer.body2: If you're experiencing concerning pain, new symptoms, or anything affecting your daily life, talk to a doctor or physiotherapist. They can do what Mindra can't.
disclaimer.short: Mindra tracks patterns. It isn't medical advice. For concerning symptoms, talk to a clinician.

quotes.q1: You showed up. That's the whole thing.
quotes.q2: Today counts. Even if it was small.
quotes.q4: The body remembers consistency, not intensity.
quotes.q5: Soft days are part of the practice.
quotes.q6: Health is not supposed to feel like a punishment.
quotes.q7: You're allowed to recover before you collapse.
quotes.q9: You're allowed to take it gently.
quotes.q10: Doing less than planned is not the same as doing nothing.
quotes.q11: A regulated nervous system is progress, too.
quotes.q12: A bad workout still counts. A short workout still counts. Stretching in pajamas still counts.
quotes.q13: Some days are about staying in the room.
quotes.q14: You don't owe anyone a hard workout.
quotes.q15: Patience is a kind of strength.
quotes.q17: Your pace is the right pace.
quotes.q18: The goal is sustainability, not self-destruction.
quotes.q19: Consistency built gently lasts longer than motivation built violently.
quotes.q20: Adaptation is not the same as giving up.
quotes.q22: You do not need to earn rest.
quotes.q27: The work counts even when it feels small.
quotes.q28: A gentle day is a strong day.
quotes.q30: Rest is not a reward, it's maintenance.

kindMode.title: Kind mode
kindMode.blurb: Tools for tougher days. Turn on what helps; leave the rest. You can flip everything at once with the master switch, or fine-tune below.
kindMode.masterDescription: Turns on every option below until you turn it off.
kindMode.individualBlurb: These persist independently. Master overrides them while it's on.
kindMode.kindSoftLanguage_description: Replaces direct phrases with gentler ones.
kindMode.kindHideTotals_description: Hides volume sums and total weight labels.
kindMode.kindHideCounts_description: Hides set counts and other tallies when not essential.
kindMode.kindWordCheckIn_description: Replaces the pain slider with simple words.

cloud.title: Cloud backup
cloud.blurb: Sign in to back up your data and sync across devices. Your data stays local until you sign in.
cloud.linkSentBlurb: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device.
cloud.signedInBlurb: Signed in. Data backup will be enabled in the next update.
